detected_fault: Resolution loading issues with black bars on screen
suggested_solution: Check for updated NVIDIA drivers from Nvidia's page and install the latest version.
Install Intel GPU drivers from Dell Support site.
Use Display Driver Uninstaller (DDU) to uninstall all NVIDIA graphic drivers in safe mode, then reinstall the latest ones.
Reinstall GeForce Experience app separately from Dell drivers.
Check for global sharpening settings in Nvidia Control Panel and reset it to default if necessary.
